plainTranslation: A's drive meets B's feelings. The sextile supports them, if you act on it.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Synced from authored synastry bundle synastry-authored__19_ (2).json.
summaryDeep: Their initiative, urgency, directness, and temper work smoothly with your feelings, needs, and sense of safety. It runs easily and asks little, quietly steadying the rest of the bond. Lean on how naturally this one lines up.
tension: The hard part is letting it stay too quiet. You may both feel the pull, but wait for the other person to make it obvious. You may care, but not say much. You may want closeness, but keep acting casual. Then the connection stays smaller than it has to.
advice: Do not just sit on the feeling. Say it, show it, reach for it. This one gets stronger when someone gives the warmth something real to do.
summaryShort: Their initiative, urgency, directness, and temper work smoothly with your feelings, needs, and sense of safety.
